item.title: Harold “DeeDee” George Aucoin

item.title: Budget passes, but tempers flare at Council Meet
item.description: The Review/Howard J. Castay Parish councilman Rev. Craig Mathews and St. Mary President Sam Jones traded barbs on funding various projects at Wednesday’s council meeting. Franklin - The St Mary Parish Council passed its 2026 fiscal year budget on Wednesday, but not before making last minute changes to restore $17,000 to one program, but slice $500,000 from another.

item.description: The Review/Howard J. Castay Berwick Police Chief J.P. Henry, left, announced the promotion of Berwick Lt. Detective Quentin Menard to Assistant Police Chief of the Town of Berwick. item.title: Horseshoe pitcher Hall of Fame
item.description: Linda Dodson Linda Dodson is the 10th Member of the Bayou Horseshoe Pitchers Association to be inducted into the Louisiana State Horseshoe Pitchers Hall of Fame and the 30th in Louisiana since 1997.
